shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A man in an orange shirt sits at the screen-side window seat and opens the case consultation, a woman in a white shirt sits at the door-side window seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt and the woman in a white shirt swap the screen-side window seat and the door-side window seat, and she asks about the case details.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt answers the question.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
